layout: 64x64 2x2 sheet, tracking compasses top row, sealed lava cores bottom row

tasks.name: 추적 나침반 A · 원반형
tasks.description: 정면에서 본 둥근 금빛 나침반과 붉은 불씨 지시침
tasks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, tiny pixel-art inventory relic.
Asset type: ONE 32x32 fantasy magic relic icon, one of a matched exclusive set for the weapon Crimson Limit.
Image 1 is the WEAPON IDENTITY reference: red orb supported by gold-orange branching prongs. Borrow its red center and thick gold embracing shapes, not its long staff or its crop. Image 2 is the APPROVED PIXEL STYLE reference: five clean chunky fire relics. Do not copy those five objects.
Make a new self-contained magical relic with a thick golden casing and RED central magic. It must feel like a portable ancient artifact sharing the weapon's core design language. Use the existing fire-family colors with a more prominent gold enclosure and red center.
Intended logical canvas EXACTLY 32x32. Deliberately low resolution: large connected flat color clusters and square equal-size pixels, sparse broad shading planes. A uniform TWO logical pixel thick dark charcoal outer contour. Every visible pixel INCLUDING outline stays within x=2..29, y=2..29, leaving at least TWO transparent logical pixels on each side. Center it and keep compact substantial proportions, no skinny stalks. Integer enlarged presentation is acceptable only if every logical pixel remains an equal square.
Only SIX opaque colors in the entire icon, including the outline: charcoal #363232; muted red shadow #A75064; red magic #E55C5C; orange metal shade #E09656; yellow GOLD #EECF5A; warm cream #F1E9D4 for a SMALL highlight. Use all six meaningfully. The housing reads golden, the core or indicator reads red. No silver, blue, green, extra brown or pink.
Two short thick gold prongs on the upper shoulders echo the weapon head; integrate them into the casing, keep them subordinate and blunt. They must not become ears, a creature face, thin wires or detached stars.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Exactly one isolated complete icon, not a sheet. No text, numbers, letters, grid, frame around the image, UI, watermark, chains, ribbons, smoke trails, flying sparks, outside glow, cast shadow, glossy specular rendering, gradients, antialiasing, dithering, tiny engravings, noisy textures, weapon shaft or human hand. Every part is readable at native 32x32.

DESIGN: EMBER-TRACKING MAGIC COMPASS, VARIANT A, FRONT VIEW ROUND DISC.
A chunky circular gold compass housing viewed almost straight-on. A broad gold rim with orange lower-right edge surrounds a simple muted-red inset face. In the center, a SINGLE LARGE RED ember-shaped arrowhead points diagonally upper RIGHT, its pointed end has a tiny cream highlight and its short tail is a broad connected shape. The arrow is fat enough to read at 32 pixels; no hairline needle. Include only TWO small thick gold rectangular orientation marks on the inner rim, no compass rose, no letters, no many ticks. Two short upward gold shoulder prongs merge with the top rim to subtly echo the staff head. A simple shallow red/orange lower tab gives the object weight. Overall silhouette is a flat round magic navigation instrument, distinguishable from a medallion by the clear directional ember indicator.

DESIGN: SEALED LAVA CORE, VARIANT A, SPHERICAL CORE WITH TWO CROSSED GOLD BANDS.

One band wraps as a broad diagonal from upper-left to lower-right, the other wraps around its middle at a different angle to create clear three-dimensional overlap. Red core remains visible in large uninterrupted round lobes between bands, with one broad muted-red lower-right shadow plane and one small orange hot patch.
